# DSH AI Providers
[](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=Firefox2100_dsh-ai-providers) [](https://sonarcloud.io/
summary/new_code?id=Firefox2100_dsh-ai-providers) [](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=Firef
ox2100_dsh-ai-providers)
Reusable, provider-neutral AI services for DeepSeek Harness.
English | 简体中文
DSH AI Providers is infrastructure for plugins that need AI capabilities beyond a single model backe
nd. Users register a vendor connection and credential once, then reuse it for every capability that
vendor supplies. Consumer plugins call stable services instead of implementing credentials, provider
selection, concurrency control, and vendor APIs themselves.
It currently covers:

ch and speech-to-text;
- image generation.
The project is primarily useful to plugin developers and to users of plugins built on it. Installing
it alone does not add an assistant or start making AI requests: configure the providers you need, t
hen install or build a plugin that consumes the services.
## Why use it
- Configure a connection and DSH-managed credential once instead of repeating secrets in every featu

re or plugin.
- Let users choose or change providers without coupling consumer plugins to vendor-spe

cific APIs.
- Share capability contracts, live configuration, and concurrency limits across plugins.
- Retain vendor-specific controls where a common interface would otherwise hide useful behavior.
The provider-neutral contracts are the foundation. A provider can be added behind those contracts wi
thout requiring each consumer plugin to add another vendor transport.
## How it fits together
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Consumer plugins depend on the contracts, not a particular vendor package. The runtime exposes the p
rovider selected in the profile and applies shared concurrency controls. Provider packages keep owne
rship of their connections, request defaults, and vendor-specific settings.

## Installation
DSH AI Providers requires Node.js 22 or later and currently targets DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1 || >=0.
requires Node.js 22 or later and currently targets DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1 || >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2`.
Install the bundle into a DSH profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The bundle installs the runtime and all provider packages maintained by this project. Restart the pr
ofile, configure reusable endpoints and credentials under **Settings > Providers**, then choose mode
ls and parameters in each service page. Individual packages may also be installed separately for a c
in each service page. Individual packages may also be installed separately for a custom deployment.
To use these language-model routes in place of DSH's stock routes, disable `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-
ai` and the stock `ui-settings-models` settings page in that profile. Keep DSH's core `llm` service
enabled. For DSH Voice Input, keep its speech-to-text registry enabled but select the API-backed pro
vider instead of the built-in SenseVoice provider.
This is an independent project maintained by Firefox2100. It is not an official DeepSeek Harness pro
ject and is not maintained or endorsed by the DSH maintainers.
## For plugin developers
Consumer plugins normally add `@dsh-ai-providers/core` as a dependency and request the services they
use from the Cordis context. Provider authors implement the same contracts and register their capab
ilities with the runtime.
Start with Using services for a consumer integration, or Creating a provider for a new backend. The
core contract reference documents lifecycle rules, errors, and request types.
## Development
Requires Node.js 22 or later and pnpm.
